complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement Core macOS Window Management Functions

For each subtask, include research on required macOS APIs, implementation details, error handling, and testing approach.

Each function needs proper error handling and must return complex ToolResult objects with screenshots. The implementation will require working with low-level system APIs and handling various edge cases.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement Screenshot Capture and Clipboard Access

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Design and Implement ToolResult and ToolCollection Primitives
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the implementation of ToolResult and ToolCollection primitives into subtasks: 1) Implement ToolResult struct with serialization, 2) Design and implement Tool trait with parameter schema handling, 3) Implement ToolCollection with tool management methods, 4) Create ToolDescription for LLM consumption with serialization support.

It requires careful API design, proper trait implementation, serialization/deserialization support, and error handling. The complexity comes from ensuring these primitives are flexible enough to support all tool types while maintaining a clean interface.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide the LLM interaction module implementation into subtasks: 1) Design and implement provider-agnostic interfaces (LLMProvider enum, LLMConfig struct, Message enum), 2) Implement Anthropic Claude API client, 3) Implement OpenAI API client, 4) Implement Google API client, 5) Create the LLMInterface with unified request/response handling.

It requires handling various message types, including tool calls and results, and managing asynchronous API requests. The implementation needs to be provider-agnostic while supporting provider-specific features.
